eyebrow: The rollback plan, written before go-live
code:
Rollback trigger (any one is sufficient):
  - confirmed domain-separation leak
  - misrouted tickets above 10% of pilot volume
  - P1 integration failure, no workaround in 1 day

Rollback action (St. Catherine's domain ONLY):
  - route new tickets back to legacy process
  - deactivate St. Catherine's catalog + flow
  - Lakeshore and Prairie View: unaffected

Decision window: 5 business days of pilot data
caption: Domain Separation makes this a one-domain rollback, never an all-or-nothing one.

code:
Context:     Prairie View's system has no webhook,
             only a read endpoint.

Options:     A. force a new webhook build
             B. a scheduled pull (chosen)
             C. manual CSV import

Decision:    B -- scheduled pull, coalesced,
             every 15 minutes.

Consequences: accepts a 15-min staleness window;
              avoids Option A's deadline risk and
              C's audit gap.
caption: Context, options, decision, consequences -- written down while the reasoning is fresh.
